assessment: The F-5-pilot story is best treated as a conflation of at least four distinct aviation events.

records.event: Israeli forces reported destroying two Iranian F-5s and one F-4 preparing to take off at Tabriz.
records.crew_status: Not established here; aircraft-loss record does not prove Camp Buehring crews were aboard.

records.event: Three Iranian pilots later claimed they flew a very-low-level strike on Camp Buehring, Kuwait; they claimed their raid contributed to Kuwaiti friendly-fire shootdowns of three U.S. F-15Es.
records.crew_status: All three claimants appeared alive in June 17 state-TV interview. Specific causal claim for F-15 losses remains unproven; CENTCOM confirmed Kuwaiti friendly fire during active combat involving Iranian aircraft/missiles/drones.

records.event: Qatar announced its air force shot down two Iranian Su-24s entering/approaching Qatari territory.
records.crew_status: By Aug 15 Qatar said remains of one pilot had been recovered and denied detaining Iranian pilots; Iran disputed the account and sought a fact-finding process.

records.event: CENTCOM strike footage/OSINT geolocation identified destruction at Ahvaz/Qasem Soleimani International Airport, 31.33563, 48.76275.
records.crew_status: Ground aircraft; no pilot-loss inference. Operational status of every parked airframe is not established by the reviewed evidence.
